# MaxLinear, Inc. Announces Upcoming Financial Conference Participation


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_cfc99aac2d15ede4067ecbd0a70f3f97/maxlinear/news/2026-11-17_MaxLinear_Inc_Announces_Upcoming_Financial_631.pdf) November 17, 2026


CARLSBAD, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- MaxLinear, Inc. (Nasdaq: MXL), a leading provider of radio frequency (RF), analog, digital and mixed-signal integrated circuits, today announced that it will participate in the upcoming financial conferences:


- UBS Global Technology and AI Conference in Scottsdale on Nov. 30th. MaxLinear’s presentation is scheduled for 4:55 p.m. MT. A webcast of the session will be available at[https://investors.maxlinear.com](https://investors.maxlinear.com/) .
- Wells Fargo 9th Annual TMT Summit in Rancho Palos Verdes on Dec. 8th. MaxLinear’s presentation is scheduled for 3:00 p.m. PT. A webcast of the session will be available at[https://investors.maxlinear.com](https://investors.maxlinear.com/) .
- Barclays 24th Annual Global Technology Conference in San Francisco on Dec. 10th. MaxLinear’s presentation is scheduled for 8:45 a.m. PT. A webcast of the session will be available at[https://investors.maxlinear.com](https://investors.maxlinear.com/) .
- Northland Virtual Growth Conference 2026 on Dec. 16th.
- Needham 29th Annual Growth Conference in New York on Jan. 12, 2027. Presentation details will be available on the investor relations page at[https://investors.maxlinear.com](https://investors.maxlinear.com/) .


**About MaxLinear, Inc.**


MaxLinear, Inc. (Nasdaq:MXL) is a leading provider of radio frequency (RF), analog, digital and mixed-signal integrated circuits for access and connectivity, wired and wireless infrastructure, and industrial and multi-market applications. MaxLinear is headquartered in Carlsbad, California. For more information, please visit[www.maxlinear.com](https://www.maxlinear.com/) .


MXL is MaxLinear’s registered trademark. Other trademarks appearing herein are the property of their respective owners.
